parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: implement audit record reduction and report generation supporting on-demand review without altering content or time ordering

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: integrate audit record review, triage, analysis and reporting with governance and incident management

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: detect malicious activity even when it evades standard signature-based solutions or such solutions are undeployable

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: define examples of abnormal system behaviour to aid detection of hard-to-identify malicious activity

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: implement reasonable and proportionate measures detecting malicious activity affecting Functions and Data protection

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: monitor security alerts and advisories and respond using agreed and managed indicators of compromise

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: detect unauthorised hardware, software and firmware, then disable network access, isolate components and notify security operations

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: implement well-defined, tested incident management processes ensuring continuity of Functions and Data protection

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: have an up-to-date incident response plan grounded in risk assessment, covering a range of incident scenarios

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: be capable of enacting the incident response plan, limiting impact and coordinating incident handling with contingency planning

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: exercise response plans at least every 12 months using past incidents and threat-intelligence-informed scenarios

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: establish an operational incident handling capability covering preparation, detection, forensic analysis, containment, recovery and reporting

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: conduct data exfiltration tests at network boundaries at least every 12 months against authorised and covert channels

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: audit the identity of internal users associated with denied communications

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: incorporate root cause analysis and lessons learned into response procedures, with improvements implemented within 30 days of analysis

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: perform Business Continuity Risk Assessments for outage or Data Breach risks, recorded in a risk register with mitigating controls

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: assess the requirement for redundant networking and telecommunication systems, implementing and protecting them where required
